title: Deictic Refusal Uncertainty Envelope
purpose: Keep ambiguous learner refusal targets provisional until a human-confirmed, scope-bounded referent is available.
rules: Local conversation and WorldSpec pointers may suggest candidate referents but never prove learner meaning.
An unresolved referent may not be stored or enforced as a confirmed refusal target, even when only one candidate appears likely.
Target-specific suppression requires an explicitly learner-confirmed pointer to a candidate in the same scoped context.
Ambiguous refusal may defer target-specific action without obligating the human to clarify or authorizing an interruption.
Candidate pointers preserve their individual source references; no raw private dialogue is copied into generalized research memory.
A local refusal never automatically becomes a parent-task, parent-purpose, person, or enduring preference boundary.
Synthetic contract examples do not become observed human evidence or authorize runtime changes.
